claim_text: On the datasets whose published grouping satisfies split_unit: specimen, the frozen real olfactory connectome reservoir (R0) achieves a higher macro-F1 than the degree-preserving rewired control (R2)
R0 achieves higher macro-F1 than an echo-state network (R4) with matched size and edge density.
R0 achieves higher macro-F1 than a random sparse reservoir (R3) with matched node and edge count.
R0 achieves higher macro-F1 than a tuned GRU baseline.
R0 retains a larger fraction of its full-data macro-F1 than R4 at 10% and 25% training specimens (low-data robustness).
R0 degrades less than R4 under sensor-channel dropout at p_drop in {0.1..0.5}.
